services.name: Private Sunset Tour
services.desc: Experience the magic of a Florida sunset like never before on our Sunset Serenity Boat Tour. 2 hours About Experience the magic of a Florida sunset like never before on our Sunset Serenity Boat Tour. As the sun dips below the horizon, casting a golden glow over the tranquil waters of Anna Maria Island, you'll be treated to breathtaking views and a serene atmosphere. We’ll anchor up to watch the sun sink into the water, then safely venture back to the dock to end the 2 Hours • Up to 6 people • Gorgeous views!
